description: Use this when calling a third-party L402 API or capability (ai_inference with prompt/messages from ~$0.0024; web_search with query) with one BitTuitive payment (sats or USDC via x402) and automatic fallback. Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

credit.description: 24h credit token from failed routed call.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).
